meta.name: CCNL Operai Agricoli e Florovivaisti — Coldiretti/Confagricoltura/CIA
signatories: Assoverde — Associazione Italiana Costruttori del Verde

sources.notes: INPS Circolare n. 94 del 13/11/2024 — Allegato 1: minimi salariali mensili di area in vigore dall'1.1.2023 (Area1=1389.15, Area2=1266.90, Area3=944.62). Fonte primaria per periodi 2022-2025.
Dottrinalavoro — Retribuzioni al 1° gennaio 2025: minimi OTI agricoltura (Area1=1458.61, Area2=1330.25, Area3=991.85). Confermato coerente con +5% su valori INPS Jan 2023.

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated retribuzione tabellare minima (paga base + contingenza + EDR merged since 01/01/2009). Contingenza = 0.00 and EDR = 0.00 per ilccnl.it table. Single base_salary per area per period. Source: contratticcnl.it tabelle retributive, confirmed by research from ilccnl.it showing zero contingenza columns.

RENEWAL: CCNL signed 23/05/2022 (valid 2022-2025), renewed 28/05/2026 (quadriennio 2026-2029, signed verbale). Two salary tranches on the salary in force on 28 May 2026: +3.4% from 2026-06-01 and +1.7% from 2027-01-01, not compounded (Art. 50 and Allegato n. 1). No una tantum.

LEVELS: Three national professional areas (OTI, Operai a Tempo Indeterminato, national minimums). Area1=Specializzati, Area2=Qualificati, Area3=Comuni. National table sets floor only; provincial contracts (contratti provinciali di lavoro) always exceed these minimums.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 169 hours/month. Formula: 39 h/week × 52 weeks / 12 = 169.00 exactly. Confirmed by ilccnl.it divisore orario field (169) and daily divisor 26 (169 / 6.5).
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 14 (tredicesima Art. 52 + quattordicesima Art. 53 CCNL). Tredicesima paid at year-end; quattordicesima paid 30 April. Both equal one full monthly retribuzione globale.

TAX SECTOR: AGRICOLTURA (new TaxSector). INPS rates: Gestione Previdenziale Speciale Agricola, OTI standard agriculture: employee 8.84%, employer 21.66%, total 30.50% (2026). Source: ciatreviso.it citing INPS 2026 rates.
CNEL CODE: A011. Confirmed from ilccnl.it page header and contratticcnl.it/ccnl/a011/. CNEL archive (cnel.it) returned 404 at time of extraction.

NATIONAL MINIMUMS ONLY. Provincial contracts (contratti provinciali di lavoro, 20 provinces) pay substantially more than national floor. The national tabella retributiva is the legal minimum. Actual employer cost in any province requires adding the CPL supplement.

limitation.remediation: Add the provincial (CPL) supplement outside the engine.

notes.text: OTI ONLY. OTD (Operai a Tempo Determinato / seasonal) workers are not modelled. OTD workers receive a Terzo Elemento of 30.44% (festività 5.45% + ferie 8.33% + tredicesima 8.33% + quattordicesima 8.33%) in lieu of accruals; the engine cannot represent this structure. OTD represent a large share of agricultural workers.

limitation.remediation: Model the OTD terzo elemento structure for fixed-term agricultural workers.

notes.text: FLOROVIVAISTI NOT DISTINGUISHED. The CCNL covers both Operai Agricoli (OTA) and Operai Florovivaisti (OTF). OTF have separate (higher) tabelle retributive with their own area amounts. This file models OTA amounts only. Callers must use a separate file (not yet modelled) for OTF workers.

limitation.remediation: Model the OTF salary tables as a separate file.

notes.text: INPS CONTRIBUTION BASE. Agricultural OTI INPS contributions are legally computed on the 'retribuzione convenzionale' (set annually by INPS decree per DL 338/1989 Art. 1), NOT on the actual contractual salary. This engine applies rates to actual gross salary. The net INPS amounts will differ from statutory computations. Figures are indicative only.

limitation.remediation: Compute agricultural INPS contributions on the retribuzione convenzionale set by INPS decree.

notes.text: INAIL NOT MODELLED. INAIL agricultural premium (8.50% unified from 2026 per new tariff) is not modelled. The engine does not track INAIL.

CNEL CODE A011 sourced from ilccnl.it and contratticcnl.it; unverified against CNEL archive (archive returned 404 at time of extraction). Code A014 belongs to a separate expired minority CCNL (ASNALI/FAGRI) — do not confuse.

SENIORITY OF THE SUPER PROFILES: Art. 54 (p. 55) pays 10,85 a month to the operai qualificati super and 11,62 to the specializzati super; the three areas of the file pay the amount of the qualificati (10,33) and of the specializzati (11,36), and the request does not say whether the operaio is a super profile.

limitation.remediation: Add the super profiles as levels with their scatto amounts.

notes.text: HISTORICAL PERIODS ADDED (2026-09-09). Three salary periods now modelled per area: (1) 2023-01-01: INPS Circ. n.94/2024 Allegato 1 (primary source, Area1=1389.15, Area2=1266.90, Area3=944.62). (2) 2025-01-01: Dottrinalavoro Jan 2025 PDF (Area1=1458.61, Area2=1330.25, Area3=991.85). Cross-check: 2025 values / 2023 values = 1.050 (approx. +5% tranche per 2022-2025 CCNL). (3) 2026-06-01: first tranche of 2026-2029 renewal (+3.4%). 2023-01-01 is the earliest verified period; pre-2023 values not modelled.

JANUARY 2027 TRANCHE: the minimi of area of Allegato n. 1 of the verbale of 28 May 2026, printed Area 1 1532,999, Area 2 1398,093, Area 3 1042,434 (the 28 May 2026 salary x 1.051) and paid to the cent: 1533.00 / 1398.09 / 1042.43. Until 14 October 2026 the bundle compounded the tranches (June 2026 x 1.017: 1533.84 / 1398.86 / 1043.00), 0.57 to 0.84 a month too much.

BILATERAL FUNDS. EBAN (Ente Bilaterale Agricolo Nazionale) and FISA (Fondo Integrativo di Settore Agricolo) bilateral fund contributions are set at provincial level and not modelled. Agrifondo (supplementary pension) contributions also omitted.

limitation.remediation: Pass the provincial EBAN, FISA and Agrifondo contributions as bilateral fund events.

notes.text: TERRITORIAL REDUCTIONS. INPS reductions for mountain/disadvantaged zones (75%/68%) are not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Model the INPS reductions for mountain and disadvantaged zones.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: ELEMENTO AGGIUNTIVO DELLA RETRIBUZIONE (Art. 54-bis, new, verbale of 28 May 2026): from 1 January 2027 a fixed-term operaio who worked at least 150 days a year for the same employer for three consecutive years receives, from the fourth year, 0.4% of the salario contrattuale. The request carries no history of days per employer, so it is not paid.

limitation.remediation: Add the consecutive years of at least 150 days with the employer to the request and pay 0.4% of the salary, then remove this note.

notes.text: FLOROVIVAISTI SICKNESS: the operaio florovivaista a tempo indeterminato receives from the employer, on top of the INPS indemnity, 25% of the contractual daily wage for at most 90 days a year, from the first day when the sickness lasts more than three days (Art. 62, verbale of 28 May 2026, p. 38); the file pays the operai agricoli rule, with no employer integration, and the request does not say whether the operaio is a florovivaista.

limitation.remediation: Split the florovivaisti into their own levels or file, with a sickness rule paying 25% of the daily wage for 90 days a year past the third day.

notes.text: FLOROVIVAISTI OVERTIME AND HOLIDAY WORK: the operai florovivaisti are paid 29% overtime, 40% holiday work, 48% night work, 50% holiday overtime and 55% night holiday work (Art. 44, p. 49), against the 25, 35, 40, 40 and 45% of the operai agricoli (Art. 43) the file pays; ordinary holiday work (35% and 40%) has no band. The request does not say whether the operaio is a florovivaista. The rates apply to the provincial salario contrattuale.

limitation.remediation: Split the florovivaisti into their own levels or file with the Art. 44 rates.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP (Allegato n. 10, CCNL 23 May 2022, pp. 122-123): two levels below the destination in the first 12 months, one level below in the next 12, the destination in the last 12 (Area 1 and 2: 36 months; Area 3: 24 months, from one level below, only for the highest provincial level of the area). The levels are the provincial professional levels inside each area, not the three national areas the file holds: the file places an Area1 apprentice at the Area3 and then the Area2 minimum, a reading the text does not support. A fixed-term apprentice operaio is never paid below the lowest level of the destination area (p. 125).

limitation.remediation: Model the provincial levels of each area, or pass the apprentice classification of the provincial contract.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: P1 audit: the salary tranches of the renewal of 28 May 2026 against the signed verbale (Art. 50, Art. 54-bis, Allegato n. 1).
findings: Allegato n. 1 prints the minimi of area 1532,999 / 1398,093 / 1042,434: the January 2027 salaries, compounded in the bundle (1533.84 / 1398.86 / 1043.00), are corrected to the printed minimi taken to the cent (1533.00 / 1398.09 / 1042.43) and verified.
June 2026: +3.4% of the 28 May 2026 salary (Art. 50): derived, the verbale prints no amount.
Art. 54-bis (0.4% for fixed-term workers with three years of 150 days) is new and not modelled: declared.
Art. 54 (seniority) is not amended by the verbale; the amounts stay aggregator-sourced (seniority_amounts_unconfirmed).

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL A011 matches; the verbale of 28 May 2026 is signed by Confagricoltura, Coldiretti and CIA with FLAI, FAI and UILA. The report also lists Assoverde, API, the family-farm federations and UGL Agroalimentare as parties of the earlier text.
Term: the verbale renews the CCNL 'scaduto il 31 dicembre 2025' and is titled 2026-2029 (quadriennale): 1/1/2026 to 31/12/2029.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili': the overtime bands and the night, holiday and shift premiums of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: The overtime bands (20% weekday, 40% night, 50% holiday) stay derived: the CCNL of 23 May 2022 is not published by a party, and the verbale of 28 May 2026 does not amend the overtime article. Provincial contracts may set higher rates.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'ferie, permessi, festività, assenze, malattia e comporto': the leave, accrual, absence and sickness rules of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Ferie 26 working days (Art. 36, p. 22), comporto 180 days (Art. 61, p. 37) and daily divisor 26 (Art. 50, p. 29): match and verified, cited to the verbale of 28 May 2026 instead of an aggregator.
Art. 62 (p. 38) gives the florovivaisti an employer integration of 25% of the daily wage for 90 days a year that the single file cannot pay: declared as an outside-input limitation.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'scatti di anzianità, indennità e altri elementi fissi', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Art. 54 (p. 55): the scatti are biennial, not triennial: cadence corrected from 36 to 24 months; amounts 8,99 / 10,33 / 11,36 and the maximum of 5 match: verified. The super profiles (10,85 and 11,62) are declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'straordinario, notturno, festivo, turni e maggiorazioni cumulabili', re-read on the full text published by a party, found on 15 October 2026.
findings: Art. 43 (p. 48): straordinario 25% (was 20%), straordinario festivo 40% (was 50%), notturno 40%, festivo notturno 45% (added): corrected and verified. The florovivaisti rates of Art. 44 (p. 49) are declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova', re-read on the full text published by a party.
findings: Allegato n. 10 (pp. 122-125): the under-classification counts provincial levels inside the areas, not the national areas the file uses: apprentice runs are now blocked by a limitation instead of paying the Area3 and Area2 minima.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'confrontare lordo, netto e costo azienda con esempi indipendenti': a run of the engine against the labour cost table of the Regione Toscana price list (Allegato 3, section 4, operai agricoli e florovivaisti, CCNL 2022-2025).
findings: The table prices the provincial wages of Firenze, Arezzo and the other provinces, not the national area minima of the file: only its structure compares. TFR: 1.312,85 on 17.723,44 a year is 1/13.5, as the engine accrues (991.85 / 13.5 = 73.47 for Area3). Match.

Deviation: the table's employer contributions in zona normale are 35.37% of the pay including INAIL; the engine applies 33.953% including the 8.50% INAIL of INPS circ. 43/2026 (25.453% without it). Cause not established (the table states neither its year nor its composition beyond the INAIL share of 13.24%); decision: flagged, the engine keeps the rates of circ. 43/2026. No independent net pay example.

reviews.scope: Closure of the divergence left open by the review 2026-10-15-ai-cost-check: the employer contributions against the labour cost table of the Regione Toscana price list.
findings: Year: the price list is the edition of December 2025 (file metadata 2 December 2025; the idraulico-forestale tables are dated 2025 and 2026), but its agricultural section (pp. 29-37) is headed 'CCNL operai agricoli e flovivaistici 2022-2025', prices the provincial wages of that contract and states 'in agricoltura i contributi inail sono compresi nell'inps e sono il 13,24% del totale'. The 2026 rates replace the INAIL share with the unified 8.50% of INPS circ. 43/2026, which the engine applies. The table's 35.37% (6.268,78 on 17.723,44, Firenze e Prato, comune) is built on rates before 2026 and does not split them further.
The engine keeps the 2026 rates of circ. 43/2026; the table compares for the TFR structure only.

divergences.subject: Employer contributions of an operaio comune in zona normale: 35.37% of the pay with INAIL in the Regione Toscana table against 33.953% with the 8.50% INAIL in the engine for 2026.
divergences.cause: The table applies the agricultural rates of the CCNL 2022-2025 years, INAIL included as 13.24% of the total, not the 2026 rates with the unified INAIL of INPS circ. 43/2026: it is no evidence for 2026 contributions.
divergences.evidence: Regione Toscana price list, Allegato 3, section 4, pp. 29-37 (sha256 2c3f7282...); the comparison test keeps the TFR structure only.
